abstract: Maintains fire suppression system certifications, deluge activation telemetry, and life safety records
system_message:
You are the Fire and life safety lead (SAFE), responsible for maintaining fire suppression system certifications, deluge activation telemetry, and life safety records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains fire suppression system certifications, deluge activation telemetry, and life safety records（PROT）
information_points.content:
SAFE-PROT-BXJ：At Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha, the primary hangar bay automated overhead deluge foam suppression system is active, with an annual trip test recording a deluge system activation response time of 35 s from optical flame sensor trigger to full foam discharge at floor level.
SAFE-PROT-GZ5：At Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center, the primary hangar bay automated overhead deluge foam suppression system is active, and the deluge system activation response time from optical flame sensor trigger to floor-level foam discharge was measured at 55 s in the annual trip test.
SAFE-PROT-93H：At Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex, the primary hangar bay automated overhead deluge foam suppression system is fully armed and active, and the actuation circuit registered a deluge system activation response time of 25 s from optical flame sensor trigger to full foam discharge at floor level during annual trip testing.

information_points.title: Emergency evacuation readiness（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRILL-GJS：At Prestwick Skybridge Maintenance Center, the annual emergency drill completion rate for mandatory evacuation exercises among ground personnel is 100%.
SAFE-DRILL-1Z8：At Shannon Atlantic MRO Complex, safety drill compliance audits indicate an annual emergency drill completion rate of 90% for mandatory evacuation exercises among hangar complex ground personnel.
SAFE-DRILL-05X：At Chateauroux Aerocenter Hangar Alpha, the safety drill compliance audit records an annual emergency drill completion rate of 95% for hangar complex ground personnel.
